frozen_analysis_protocol.evaluation_order: training all seeds and validation selection; pilot-only precision/runtime; freeze this protocol; then locked outcomes

gate.action_distribution: report all six action counts/fractions, entropy and argmax share descriptively; no diversity gate
gate.bootstrap: Two-way crossed bootstrap: independently resample checkpoint/training-seed IDs and world-seed IDs with replacement within each fixed family; preserve candidate/baseline pairing in each cell; report 95% percentile CI and two-way cluster-robust sensitivity. For heuristic baseline, do not count duplicated heuristic values as independent checkpoint information. Causal single-checkpoint comparisons resample paired world seeds only.
gate.precision: Pilot estimates episode-level variance and crossed seed correlations only. Before test outcomes, freeze counts at >=10 training seeds and >=30 world seeds/family/arm, increasing using reserve as needed so planned 95% CI half-width <= 0.5 smallest margin: 5% of absolute baseline return for utility; 0.025 probability for the 0.05 causal influence margin. If infeasible, report underpowered/inconclusive; never lower margin or interpret null as equivalence.
gate.primary_family_margin: trained mean return exceeds each baseline by >=5% of that baseline absolute mean, with paired 95% CI strictly above zero; if baseline absolute mean <0.1, use pilot-derived absolute margin fixed before test access
gate.primary_learning_outcome: per episode world return; per (training-seed/checkpoint, world-seed, family) paired cumulative toy reward differences
gate.secondary_family_rule: at least one secondary family has positive mean difference and paired 95% CI strictly above zero against both baselines; no family may have statistically supported harm beyond 10% of baseline absolute mean (or frozen pilot-derived absolute margin if baseline near zero)

prohibitions: Do not inspect locked-test outcomes before training conditions, sample count, model/checkpoint selection protocol, analysis code, and acceptance thresholds are frozen.
No locked test seed may be used for training, checkpoint selection, hyperparameter/reward tuning, or intervention selection.
No artificial action-diversity constraint, action filtering, failed-run exclusion, or reward manipulation to pass a gate.
Alternate reward and matched-random inference are exploratory diagnostics only and cannot select/promote a checkpoint.

limitations: synthetic software rewards and normalized toy drives are not validated cattle behavior or biology
untrained and trained are deterministic argmax policies; heuristic is deterministic baseline
precision threshold is preregistered but not estimated-adjusted; report interval and gate directly
per-tick outputs preserve all outcomes; no run is excluded
